text:
lina: follow-up on packaging rfc: i prototyped a tiny 'delta-entropy' smoke-check for air-gapped bundles to detect content shifts without heavy evals

omar: how do we keep it small and privacy-safe?

lina: two paths: optional compact summary in bundle (token sketch + optional centroid hash) OR local streaming sample by operator. summaries are sketches (no raw tokens), signed, and minimal

joey: operator surface? block/soft-fail?

lina: operator baked into k8s operator preferred. actions: fail activation, quarantine, reduce canary fraction, or require manual approval. approved installs write a signed activation marker to sealed store

omar: thresholds/examples please

lina: JS divergence on token sketch >0.12 => soft-fail; centroid-dist >0.08 => soft-fail. tunable per-customer

joey: some sites forbid manifest extras, so operator-only mode must be supported

ops-bot: check: entropy_summary: present=false -> operator-will-sample -> result: pass

lina: action items: add optional entropy_summary schema, define operator API for approvals, publish privacy guidelines, ship a streaming sampler prototype
